+using System;
+using System.Collections.Generic;
+using System.Linq;
+using System.Threading;
+using Cysharp.Threading.Tasks;
+using Lighthouse;
+using Lighthouse.Scene;
+using Lighthouse.Scene.SceneBase;
+using Lighthouse.Scene.SceneCamera;
+using UnityEngine.SceneManagement;
+
+namespace DungeonInn.Runtime.Scripts.Core
+{
+    public sealed class ProductMainSceneManager : IMainSceneManager
+    {
+        readonly Dictionary<MainSceneId, MainSceneBase> loadedScenes = new();
+
+        Func<IDisposable> enqueueParentLifetimeScope;
+
+        void IMainSceneManager.SetEnqueueParentLifetimeScope(Func<IDisposable> enqueueParentLifetimeScope)
+        {
+            this.enqueueParentLifetimeScope = enqueueParentLifetimeScope;
+        }
+
+        ISceneCamera[] IMainSceneManager.GetSceneCameraList(SceneTransitionDiff sceneTransitionDiff)
+        {
+            return loadedScenes.TryGetValue(sceneTransitionDiff.NextMainSceneId, out var scene)
+                ? scene.GetSceneCameraList()
+                : Array.Empty<ISceneCamera>();
+        }
+
+        void IMainSceneManager.InitializeCanvas(ISceneTransitionContext context)
+        {
+            if (loadedScenes.TryGetValue(context.SceneTransitionDiff.NextMainSceneId, out var scene)
+                && scene is ICanvasSceneBase canvasSceneBase)
+            {
+                canvasSceneBase.InitializeCanvas(context.SceneCameraManager.UICamera);
+            }
+        }
+
+        async UniTask IMainSceneManager.Enter(ISceneTransitionContext context, CancellationToken cancelToken)
+        {
+            if (loadedScenes.TryGetValue(context.SceneTransitionDiff.NextMainSceneId, out var scene))
+            {
+                await scene.Enter(context, cancelToken);
+            }
+        }
+
+        async UniTask IMainSceneManager.Leave(ISceneTransitionContext context, CancellationToken cancelToken)
+        {
+            if (context.SceneTransitionDiff.CurrentMainSceneId != null
+                && loadedScenes.TryGetValue(context.SceneTransitionDiff.CurrentMainSceneId, out var scene))
+            {
+                await scene.Leave(context, cancelToken);
+            }
+        }
+
+        void IMainSceneManager.ResetInAnimation(ISceneTransitionContext context)
+        {
+            if (loadedScenes.TryGetValue(context.SceneTransitionDiff.NextMainSceneId, out var scene))
+            {
+                scene.ResetInAnimation(context);
+            }
+        }
+
+        async UniTask IMainSceneManager.PlayInAnimation(ISceneTransitionContext context)
+        {
+            if (loadedScenes.TryGetValue(context.SceneTransitionDiff.NextMainSceneId, out var scene))
+            {
+                await scene.PlayInAnimation(context);
+            }
+        }
+
+        async UniTask IMainSceneManager.PlayOutAnimation(ISceneTransitionContext context)
+        {
+            if (context.SceneTransitionDiff.CurrentMainSceneId != null
+                && loadedScenes.TryGetValue(context.SceneTransitionDiff.CurrentMainSceneId, out var scene))
+            {
+                await scene.PlayOutAnimation(context);
+            }
+        }
+
+        async UniTask IMainSceneManager.SaveSceneState(ISceneTransitionContext context, CancellationToken cancelToken)
+        {
+            if (context.SceneTransitionDiff.CurrentMainSceneId != null
+                && loadedScenes.TryGetValue(context.SceneTransitionDiff.CurrentMainSceneId, out var scene))
+            {
+                await scene.SaveSceneState(cancelToken);
+            }
+        }
+
+        async UniTask IMainSceneManager.Load(ISceneTransitionContext context)
+        {
+            if (context.SceneTransitionDiff.IsInnerGroupTransition)
+            {
+                return;
+            }
+
+            using (enqueueParentLifetimeScope.Invoke())
+            {
+                var loadOperations = context.SceneTransitionDiff.LoadMainSceneIds
+                    .Select(sceneId => (sceneId, ops: UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.LoadSceneAsync(sceneId.Name, LoadSceneMode.Additive)))
+                    .ToArray();
+
+                await UniTask.WhenAll(loadOperations.Select(x => UniTask.WaitUntil(() => x.ops.progress >= 0.9f)));
+
+                foreach (var loadOperation in loadOperations)
+                {
+                    loadOperation.ops.allowSceneActivation = true;
+                }
+
+                var scenes = await UniTask.WhenAll(loadOperations.Select(async x =>
+                {
+                    await UniTask.WaitUntil(() =>
+                    {
+                        var s = UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.GetSceneByName(x.sceneId.Name);
+                        return s.IsValid() && s.isLoaded;
+                    });
+
+                    var scene = FindSceneBase(x.sceneId);
+                    await scene.OnLoad();
+                    await x.ops.ToUniTask();
+                    return scene;
+                }));
+
+                foreach (var scene in scenes)
+                {
+                    loadedScenes.Add(scene.MainSceneId, scene);
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+        async UniTask IMainSceneManager.Unload(ISceneTransitionContext context)
+        {
+            if (context.SceneTransitionDiff.IsInnerGroupTransition)
+            {
+                return;
+            }
+
+            var unloadTargetMainScenes = loadedScenes
+                .Where(loadedScene => context.SceneTransitionDiff.UnloadMainSceneIds.Contains(loadedScene.Key))
+                .ToArray();
+
+            await UniTask.WhenAll(unloadTargetMainScenes.Select(s => s.Value.OnUnload()));
+            await UniTask.WhenAll(unloadTargetMainScenes.Select(s => UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.UnloadSceneAsync(s.Key.Name).ToUniTask()));
+
+            foreach (var unloadTargetMainScene in unloadTargetMainScenes)
+            {
+                loadedScenes.Remove(unloadTargetMainScene.Key);
+            }
+        }
+
+        void IMainSceneManager.OnSceneTransitionFinished(ISceneTransitionContext context)
+        {
+            if (loadedScenes.TryGetValue(context.SceneTransitionDiff.NextMainSceneId, out var scene))
+            {
+                scene.OnSceneTransitionFinished(context.SceneTransitionDiff);
+            }
+        }
+
+        async UniTask IMainSceneManager.PreReboot()
+        {
+            foreach (var loadedScene in loadedScenes)
+            {
+                if (loadedScene.Value.isActiveAndEnabled)
+                {
+                    await loadedScene.Value.SaveSceneState(CancellationToken.None);
+                }
+            }
+
+            loadedScenes.Clear();
+        }
+
+        static MainSceneBase FindSceneBase(MainSceneId mainSceneId)
+        {
+            try
+            {
+                return UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager
+                    .GetSceneByName(mainSceneId.Name)
+                    .GetRootGameObjects()
+                    .Select(x => x.GetComponent<MainSceneBase>())
+                    .First(x => x != null);
+            }
+            catch (InvalidOperationException)
+            {
+                LHLogger.LogError("[SceneGroup] MainSceneBase NotFound\n" +
+                                  "To add a scene, add it to UnityEditor and place a GameObject that inherits MainSceneBase at the root.");
+                throw;
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}

+using System;
+using System.Collections.Generic;
+using System.Linq;
+using System.Threading;
+using Cysharp.Threading.Tasks;
+using Lighthouse;
+using Lighthouse.Scene;
+using Lighthouse.Scene.SceneBase;
+using Lighthouse.Scene.SceneCamera;
+using UnityEngine.SceneManagement;
+
+namespace DungeonInn.Runtime.Scripts.Core
+{
+    public sealed class ProductModuleSceneManager : IModuleSceneManager
+    {
+        readonly List<ModuleSceneBase> loadedSceneModules = new();
+
+        Func<IDisposable> enqueueParentLifetimeScope;
+
+        void IModuleSceneManager.SetEnqueueParentLifetimeScope(Func<IDisposable> enqueueParentLifetimeScope)
+        {
+            this.enqueueParentLifetimeScope = enqueueParentLifetimeScope;
+        }
+
+        ISceneCamera[] IModuleSceneManager.GetSceneCameraList(ModuleSceneId[] requestSceneModuleIds)
+        {
+            return loadedSceneModules
+                .Where(s => requestSceneModuleIds.Contains(s.ModuleSceneId))
+                .SelectMany(x => x.GetSceneCameraList() ?? Array.Empty<ISceneCamera>())
+                .ToArray();
+        }
+
+        void IModuleSceneManager.ResetAnimation(ISceneTransitionContext context)
+        {
+            foreach (var targetAnimation in loadedSceneModules.Where(x => context.SceneTransitionDiff.NextSceneGroup.SceneModuleIds.Contains(x.ModuleSceneId)))
+            {
+                targetAnimation.ResetInAnimation(context);
+            }
+        }
+
+        async UniTask IModuleSceneManager.PlayInAnimation(ISceneTransitionContext context)
+        {
+            await UniTask.WhenAll(loadedSceneModules
+                .Where(x => context.SceneTransitionDiff.NextSceneGroup.SceneModuleIds.Contains(x.ModuleSceneId))
+                .Select(x => x.PlayInAnimation(context)));
+        }
+
+        async UniTask IModuleSceneManager.PlayOutAnimation(ISceneTransitionContext context)
+        {
+            if (context.SceneTransitionDiff.CurrentSceneGroup == null)
+            {
+                return;
+            }
+
+            await UniTask.WhenAll(loadedSceneModules
+                .Where(x => context.SceneTransitionDiff.CurrentSceneGroup.SceneModuleIds.Contains(x.ModuleSceneId))
+                .Select(x => x.PlayOutAnimation(context)));
+        }
+
+        async UniTask IModuleSceneManager.Load(ISceneTransitionContext context)
+        {
+            if (!context.SceneTransitionDiff.LoadSceneModuleIds.Any())
+            {
+                return;
+            }
+
+            using (enqueueParentLifetimeScope.Invoke())
+            {
+                var loadOperations = context.SceneTransitionDiff.LoadSceneModuleIds
+                    .Select(sceneId => (sceneId, ops: UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.LoadSceneAsync(sceneId.Name, LoadSceneMode.Additive)))
+                    .ToArray();
+
+                await UniTask.WhenAll(loadOperations.Select(x => UniTask.WaitUntil(() => x.ops.progress >= 0.9f)));
+
+                foreach (var loadOperation in loadOperations)
+                {
+                    loadOperation.ops.allowSceneActivation = true;
+                }
+
+                var scenes = await UniTask.WhenAll(loadOperations.Select(async x =>
+                {
+                    await UniTask.WaitUntil(() =>
+                    {
+                        var s = UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.GetSceneByName(x.sceneId.Name);
+                        return s.IsValid() && s.isLoaded;
+                    });
+
+                    var scene = FindSceneBase(x.sceneId);
+                    await scene.OnLoad();
+                    await x.ops.ToUniTask();
+                    return scene;
+                }));
+
+                loadedSceneModules.AddRange(scenes);
+            }
+        }
+
+        async UniTask IModuleSceneManager.Unload(ISceneTransitionContext context)
+        {
+            if (!context.SceneTransitionDiff.UnloadSceneModuleIds.Any())
+            {
+                return;
+            }
+
+            var unloadSceneModules = loadedSceneModules
+                .Where(x => context.SceneTransitionDiff.UnloadSceneModuleIds.Contains(x.ModuleSceneId))
+                .ToArray();
+
+            await UniTask.WhenAll(unloadSceneModules.Select(s => s.OnUnload()));
+            await UniTask.WhenAll(unloadSceneModules.Select(s => UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.UnloadSceneAsync(s.ModuleSceneId.Name).ToUniTask()));
+
+            foreach (var unloadSceneModule in unloadSceneModules)
+            {
+                loadedSceneModules.Remove(unloadSceneModule);
+            }
+        }
+
+        async UniTask IModuleSceneManager.Enter(ISceneTransitionContext context, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
+        {
+            await UniTask.WhenAll(loadedSceneModules
+                .Where(x => context.SceneTransitionDiff.NextSceneGroup.SceneModuleIds.Contains(x.ModuleSceneId))
+                .Select(x => x.Enter(context, cancellationToken)));
+        }
+
+        async UniTask IModuleSceneManager.Leave(ISceneTransitionContext context, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
+        {
+            if (context.SceneTransitionDiff.CurrentSceneGroup == null)
+            {
+                return;
+            }
+
+            await UniTask.WhenAll(loadedSceneModules
+                .Where(x => context.SceneTransitionDiff.CurrentSceneGroup.SceneModuleIds.Contains(x.ModuleSceneId))
+                .Select(x => x.Leave(context, cancellationToken)));
+        }
+
+        void IModuleSceneManager.InitializeCanvas(ISceneTransitionContext context)
+        {
+            foreach (var sceneModule in loadedSceneModules)
+            {
+                if (context.SceneTransitionDiff.LoadSceneModuleIds.Contains(sceneModule.ModuleSceneId)
+                    && sceneModule is ICanvasSceneBase canvasSceneModule)
+                {
+                    canvasSceneModule.InitializeCanvas(context.SceneCameraManager.UICamera);
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+        void IModuleSceneManager.OnSceneTransitionFinished(ISceneTransitionContext context)
+        {
+            foreach (var sceneModule in loadedSceneModules)
+            {
+                if (context.SceneTransitionDiff.NextSceneGroup.SceneModuleIds.Contains(sceneModule.ModuleSceneId))
+                {
+                    sceneModule.OnSceneTransitionFinished(context.SceneTransitionDiff);
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+        UniTask IModuleSceneManager.PreReboot()
+        {
+            loadedSceneModules.Clear();
+            return UniTask.CompletedTask;
+        }
+
+        static ModuleSceneBase FindSceneBase(ModuleSceneId moduleSceneId)
+        {
+            try
+            {
+                return UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager
+                    .GetSceneByName(moduleSceneId.Name)
+                    .GetRootGameObjects()
+                    .Select(x => x.GetComponent<ModuleSceneBase>())
+                    .First(x => x != null);
+            }
+            catch (InvalidOperationException)
+            {
+                LHLogger.LogError($"[ModuleSceneManager] SceneModule NotFound {moduleSceneId}");
+                throw;
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}

new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..a195f57339582648a40cafedfde1f6d393b3befc
--- /dev/null
+++ b/Client/Assets/DungeonInn/Runtime/Scripts/Core/ProductMainSceneManager.cs

+using System;
+using System.Collections.Generic;
+using System.Linq;
+using System.Threading;
+using Cysharp.Threading.Tasks;
+using Lighthouse;
+using Lighthouse.Scene;
+using Lighthouse.Scene.SceneBase;
+using Lighthouse.Scene.SceneCamera;
+using UnityEngine.SceneManagement;
+
+namespace DungeonInn.Runtime.Scripts.Core
+{
+    public sealed class ProductMainSceneManager : IMainSceneManager
+    {
+        readonly Dictionary<MainSceneId, MainSceneBase> loadedScenes = new();
+
+        Func<IDisposable> enqueueParentLifetimeScope;
+
+        void IMainSceneManager.SetEnqueueParentLifetimeScope(Func<IDisposable> enqueueParentLifetimeScope)
+        {
+            this.enqueueParentLifetimeScope = enqueueParentLifetimeScope;
+        }
+
+        ISceneCamera[] IMainSceneManager.GetSceneCameraList(SceneTransitionDiff sceneTransitionDiff)
+        {
+            return loadedScenes.TryGetValue(sceneTransitionDiff.NextMainSceneId, out var scene)
+                ? scene.GetSceneCameraList()
+                : Array.Empty<ISceneCamera>();
+        }
+
+        void IMainSceneManager.InitializeCanvas(ISceneTransitionContext context)
+        {
+            if (loadedScenes.TryGetValue(context.SceneTransitionDiff.NextMainSceneId, out var scene)
+                && scene is ICanvasSceneBase canvasSceneBase)
+            {
+                canvasSceneBase.InitializeCanvas(context.SceneCameraManager.UICamera);
+            }
+        }
+
+        async UniTask IMainSceneManager.Enter(ISceneTransitionContext context, CancellationToken cancelToken)
+        {
+            if (loadedScenes.TryGetValue(context.SceneTransitionDiff.NextMainSceneId, out var scene))
+            {
+                await scene.Enter(context, cancelToken);
+            }
+        }
+
+        async UniTask IMainSceneManager.Leave(ISceneTransitionContext context, CancellationToken cancelToken)
+        {
+            if (context.SceneTransitionDiff.CurrentMainSceneId != null
+                && loadedScenes.TryGetValue(context.SceneTransitionDiff.CurrentMainSceneId, out var scene))
+            {
+                await scene.Leave(context, cancelToken);
+            }
+        }
+
+        void IMainSceneManager.ResetInAnimation(ISceneTransitionContext context)
+        {
+            if (loadedScenes.TryGetValue(context.SceneTransitionDiff.NextMainSceneId, out var scene))
+            {
+                scene.ResetInAnimation(context);
+            }
+        }
+
+        async UniTask IMainSceneManager.PlayInAnimation(ISceneTransitionContext context)
+        {
+            if (loadedScenes.TryGetValue(context.SceneTransitionDiff.NextMainSceneId, out var scene))
+            {
+                await scene.PlayInAnimation(context);
+            }
+        }
+
+        async UniTask IMainSceneManager.PlayOutAnimation(ISceneTransitionContext context)
+        {
+            if (context.SceneTransitionDiff.CurrentMainSceneId != null
+                && loadedScenes.TryGetValue(context.SceneTransitionDiff.CurrentMainSceneId, out var scene))
+            {
+                await scene.PlayOutAnimation(context);
+            }
+        }
+
+        async UniTask IMainSceneManager.SaveSceneState(ISceneTransitionContext context, CancellationToken cancelToken)
+        {
+            if (context.SceneTransitionDiff.CurrentMainSceneId != null
+                && loadedScenes.TryGetValue(context.SceneTransitionDiff.CurrentMainSceneId, out var scene))
+            {
+                await scene.SaveSceneState(cancelToken);
+            }
+        }
+
+        async UniTask IMainSceneManager.Load(ISceneTransitionContext context)
+        {
+            if (context.SceneTransitionDiff.IsInnerGroupTransition)
+            {
+                return;
+            }
+
+            using (enqueueParentLifetimeScope.Invoke())
+            {
+                var loadOperations = context.SceneTransitionDiff.LoadMainSceneIds
+                    .Select(sceneId => (sceneId, ops: UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.LoadSceneAsync(sceneId.Name, LoadSceneMode.Additive)))
+                    .ToArray();
+
+                await UniTask.WhenAll(loadOperations.Select(x => UniTask.WaitUntil(() => x.ops.progress >= 0.9f)));
+
+                foreach (var loadOperation in loadOperations)
+                {
+                    loadOperation.ops.allowSceneActivation = true;
+                }
+
+                var scenes = await UniTask.WhenAll(loadOperations.Select(async x =>
+                {
+                    await UniTask.WaitUntil(() =>
+                    {
+                        var s = UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.GetSceneByName(x.sceneId.Name);
+                        return s.IsValid() && s.isLoaded;
+                    });
+
+                    var scene = FindSceneBase(x.sceneId);
+                    await scene.OnLoad();
+                    await x.ops.ToUniTask();
+                    return scene;
+                }));
+
+                foreach (var scene in scenes)
+                {
+                    loadedScenes.Add(scene.MainSceneId, scene);
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+        async UniTask IMainSceneManager.Unload(ISceneTransitionContext context)
+        {
+            if (context.SceneTransitionDiff.IsInnerGroupTransition)
+            {
+                return;
+            }
+
+            var unloadTargetMainScenes = loadedScenes
+                .Where(loadedScene => context.SceneTransitionDiff.UnloadMainSceneIds.Contains(loadedScene.Key))
+                .ToArray();
+
+            await UniTask.WhenAll(unloadTargetMainScenes.Select(s => s.Value.OnUnload()));
+            await UniTask.WhenAll(unloadTargetMainScenes.Select(s => UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.UnloadSceneAsync(s.Key.Name).ToUniTask()));
+
+            foreach (var unloadTargetMainScene in unloadTargetMainScenes)
+            {
+                loadedScenes.Remove(unloadTargetMainScene.Key);
+            }
+        }
+
+        void IMainSceneManager.OnSceneTransitionFinished(ISceneTransitionContext context)
+        {
+            if (loadedScenes.TryGetValue(context.SceneTransitionDiff.NextMainSceneId, out var scene))
+            {
+                scene.OnSceneTransitionFinished(context.SceneTransitionDiff);
+            }
+        }
+
+        async UniTask IMainSceneManager.PreReboot()
+        {
+            foreach (var loadedScene in loadedScenes)
+            {
+                if (loadedScene.Value.isActiveAndEnabled)
+                {
+                    await loadedScene.Value.SaveSceneState(CancellationToken.None);
+                }
+            }
+
+            loadedScenes.Clear();
+        }
+
+        static MainSceneBase FindSceneBase(MainSceneId mainSceneId)
+        {
+            try
+            {
+                return UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager
+                    .GetSceneByName(mainSceneId.Name)
+                    .GetRootGameObjects()
+                    .Select(x => x.GetComponent<MainSceneBase>())
+                    .First(x => x != null);
+            }
+            catch (InvalidOperationException)
+            {
+                LHLogger.LogError("[SceneGroup] MainSceneBase NotFound\n" +
+                                  "To add a scene, add it to UnityEditor and place a GameObject that inherits MainSceneBase at the root.");
+                throw;
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}

+using System;
+using System.Collections.Generic;
+using System.Linq;
+using System.Threading;
+using Cysharp.Threading.Tasks;
+using Lighthouse;
+using Lighthouse.Scene;
+using Lighthouse.Scene.SceneBase;
+using Lighthouse.Scene.SceneCamera;
+using UnityEngine.SceneManagement;
+
+namespace DungeonInn.Runtime.Scripts.Core
+{
+    public sealed class ProductModuleSceneManager : IModuleSceneManager
+    {
+        readonly List<ModuleSceneBase> loadedSceneModules = new();
+
+        Func<IDisposable> enqueueParentLifetimeScope;
+
+        void IModuleSceneManager.SetEnqueueParentLifetimeScope(Func<IDisposable> enqueueParentLifetimeScope)
+        {
+            this.enqueueParentLifetimeScope = enqueueParentLifetimeScope;
+        }
+
+        ISceneCamera[] IModuleSceneManager.GetSceneCameraList(ModuleSceneId[] requestSceneModuleIds)
+        {
+            return loadedSceneModules
+                .Where(s => requestSceneModuleIds.Contains(s.ModuleSceneId))
+                .SelectMany(x => x.GetSceneCameraList() ?? Array.Empty<ISceneCamera>())
+                .ToArray();
+        }
+
+        void IModuleSceneManager.ResetAnimation(ISceneTransitionContext context)
+        {
+            foreach (var targetAnimation in loadedSceneModules.Where(x => context.SceneTransitionDiff.NextSceneGroup.SceneModuleIds.Contains(x.ModuleSceneId)))
+            {
+                targetAnimation.ResetInAnimation(context);
+            }
+        }
+
+        async UniTask IModuleSceneManager.PlayInAnimation(ISceneTransitionContext context)
+        {
+            await UniTask.WhenAll(loadedSceneModules
+                .Where(x => context.SceneTransitionDiff.NextSceneGroup.SceneModuleIds.Contains(x.ModuleSceneId))
+                .Select(x => x.PlayInAnimation(context)));
+        }
+
+        async UniTask IModuleSceneManager.PlayOutAnimation(ISceneTransitionContext context)
+        {
+            if (context.SceneTransitionDiff.CurrentSceneGroup == null)
+            {
+                return;
+            }
+
+            await UniTask.WhenAll(loadedSceneModules
+                .Where(x => context.SceneTransitionDiff.CurrentSceneGroup.SceneModuleIds.Contains(x.ModuleSceneId))
+                .Select(x => x.PlayOutAnimation(context)));
+        }
+
+        async UniTask IModuleSceneManager.Load(ISceneTransitionContext context)
+        {
+            if (!context.SceneTransitionDiff.LoadSceneModuleIds.Any())
+            {
+                return;
+            }
+
+            using (enqueueParentLifetimeScope.Invoke())
+            {
+                var loadOperations = context.SceneTransitionDiff.LoadSceneModuleIds
+                    .Select(sceneId => (sceneId, ops: UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.LoadSceneAsync(sceneId.Name, LoadSceneMode.Additive)))
+                    .ToArray();
+
+                await UniTask.WhenAll(loadOperations.Select(x => UniTask.WaitUntil(() => x.ops.progress >= 0.9f)));
+
+                foreach (var loadOperation in loadOperations)
+                {
+                    loadOperation.ops.allowSceneActivation = true;
+                }
+
+                var scenes = await UniTask.WhenAll(loadOperations.Select(async x =>
+                {
+                    await UniTask.WaitUntil(() =>
+                    {
+                        var s = UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.GetSceneByName(x.sceneId.Name);
+                        return s.IsValid() && s.isLoaded;
+                    });
+
+                    var scene = FindSceneBase(x.sceneId);
+                    await scene.OnLoad();
+                    await x.ops.ToUniTask();
+                    return scene;
+                }));
+
+                loadedSceneModules.AddRange(scenes);
+            }
+        }
+
+        async UniTask IModuleSceneManager.Unload(ISceneTransitionContext context)
+        {
+            if (!context.SceneTransitionDiff.UnloadSceneModuleIds.Any())
+            {
+                return;
+            }
+
+            var unloadSceneModules = loadedSceneModules
+                .Where(x => context.SceneTransitionDiff.UnloadSceneModuleIds.Contains(x.ModuleSceneId))
+                .ToArray();
+
+            await UniTask.WhenAll(unloadSceneModules.Select(s => s.OnUnload()));
+            await UniTask.WhenAll(unloadSceneModules.Select(s => UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.UnloadSceneAsync(s.ModuleSceneId.Name).ToUniTask()));
+
+            foreach (var unloadSceneModule in unloadSceneModules)
+            {
+                loadedSceneModules.Remove(unloadSceneModule);
+            }
+        }
+
+        async UniTask IModuleSceneManager.Enter(ISceneTransitionContext context, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
+        {
+            await UniTask.WhenAll(loadedSceneModules
+                .Where(x => context.SceneTransitionDiff.NextSceneGroup.SceneModuleIds.Contains(x.ModuleSceneId))
+                .Select(x => x.Enter(context, cancellationToken)));
+        }
+
+        async UniTask IModuleSceneManager.Leave(ISceneTransitionContext context, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
+        {
+            if (context.SceneTransitionDiff.CurrentSceneGroup == null)
+            {
+                return;
+            }
+
+            await UniTask.WhenAll(loadedSceneModules
+                .Where(x => context.SceneTransitionDiff.CurrentSceneGroup.SceneModuleIds.Contains(x.ModuleSceneId))
+                .Select(x => x.Leave(context, cancellationToken)));
+        }
+
+        void IModuleSceneManager.InitializeCanvas(ISceneTransitionContext context)
+        {
+            foreach (var sceneModule in loadedSceneModules)
+            {
+                if (context.SceneTransitionDiff.LoadSceneModuleIds.Contains(sceneModule.ModuleSceneId)
+                    && sceneModule is ICanvasSceneBase canvasSceneModule)
+                {
+                    canvasSceneModule.InitializeCanvas(context.SceneCameraManager.UICamera);
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+        void IModuleSceneManager.OnSceneTransitionFinished(ISceneTransitionContext context)
+        {
+            foreach (var sceneModule in loadedSceneModules)
+            {
+                if (context.SceneTransitionDiff.NextSceneGroup.SceneModuleIds.Contains(sceneModule.ModuleSceneId))
+                {
+                    sceneModule.OnSceneTransitionFinished(context.SceneTransitionDiff);
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+        UniTask IModuleSceneManager.PreReboot()
+        {
+            loadedSceneModules.Clear();
+            return UniTask.CompletedTask;
+        }
+
+        static ModuleSceneBase FindSceneBase(ModuleSceneId moduleSceneId)
+        {
+            try
+            {
+                return UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager
+                    .GetSceneByName(moduleSceneId.Name)
+                    .GetRootGameObjects()
+                    .Select(x => x.GetComponent<ModuleSceneBase>())
+                    .First(x => x != null);
+            }
+            catch (InvalidOperationException)

+            }
+        }

+# task_004_debug fix done
+
+## 修正内容
+
+- `Launcher.TransitionNextScene()` を `sceneManager.TransitionScene(new WorldScene.WorldTransitionData())` に戻し、Lighthouse の遷移パイプラインを通すよう修正。
+- `Launcher.LaunchProcess()` に 5 Config Repository の `UniTask.WhenAll` ロードを復元。
+- `Launcher` コンストラクタに `IWorldConfigRepository` / `IInnConfigRepository` / `IAdventurerConfigRepository` / `IMonsterConfigRepository` / `IDungeonConfigRepository` の注入を復元。
+- `AddressableAssetSettings.asset` の `m_ActivePlayerDataBuilderIndex` を `0` に変更。
+- Unity Editor 上の Addressables Play Mode builder も `ActivePlayModeDataBuilderIndex = 0` に設定。
+- Config Repository は Addressables を使用したロードに戻し、PlayMode で await が戻らない経路を避けるため `WaitForCompletion()` で取得して `ToData()` をキャッシュする実装に修正。
+- Lighthouse の `AsyncOperation` await が MainScene load 完了後に戻らず ModuleScene load に進まないため、PackageCache は触らず `ProductMainSceneManager` / `ProductModuleSceneManager` を追加し、`AsyncOperation` 完了待ちを `ToUniTask()` にした実装を登録。
+- `WorldLifetimeScope` で `WorldScene` を `RegisterComponentInHierarchy` し、`WorldScene` の `[Inject]` が実行されるよう修正。
+- `ScreenStackBackgroundInputBlocker` を `ScreenStackScene` 配下に生成し、`ScreenStack` の root count が増えないよう修正。
+
+## 確認
+
+- `uloop.cmd compile --project-path Client`
+  - `Success: true`
+  - `ErrorCount: 0`
+  - `WarningCount: 0`
+
+## 残確認
+
+- 最終 PlayMode シーン確認の直前に PowerShell プロセス自体が `-1073741502` で起動失敗する状態になったため、以下は未完了。
+  - `uloop get-logs` Error 0 の最終再確認
+  - `execute-dynamic-code` の `World[2] ScreenStack[1] HUD[1]` 最終再確認
+
+直前の切り分けでは、Addressables Play Mode builder 設定後に `World[2]` までは確認済み。その後、Lighthouse MainSceneManager の `AsyncOperation` await 停止を修正するため `ProductMainSceneManager` / `ProductModuleSceneManager` を追加し、コンパイル 0 まで確認済み。

new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..a195f57339582648a40cafedfde1f6d393b3befc

+++ b/Client/Assets/DungeonInn/Runtime/Scripts/Core/ProductMainSceneManager.cs

+using System;
+using System.Collections.Generic;
+using System.Linq;
+using System.Threading;
+using Cysharp.Threading.Tasks;
+using Lighthouse;
+using Lighthouse.Scene;
+using Lighthouse.Scene.SceneBase;
+using Lighthouse.Scene.SceneCamera;
+using UnityEngine.SceneManagement;
+
+namespace DungeonInn.Runtime.Scripts.Core
+{
+    public sealed class ProductMainSceneManager : IMainSceneManager
+    {
+        readonly Dictionary<MainSceneId, MainSceneBase> loadedScenes = new();
+
+        Func<IDisposable> enqueueParentLifetimeScope;
+
+        void IMainSceneManager.SetEnqueueParentLifetimeScope(Func<IDisposable> enqueueParentLifetimeScope)
+        {
+            this.enqueueParentLifetimeScope = enqueueParentLifetimeScope;
+        }
+
+        ISceneCamera[] IMainSceneManager.GetSceneCameraList(SceneTransitionDiff sceneTransitionDiff)
+        {
+            return loadedScenes.TryGetValue(sceneTransitionDiff.NextMainSceneId, out var scene)
+                ? scene.GetSceneCameraList()
+                : Array.Empty<ISceneCamera>();
+        }
+
+        void IMainSceneManager.InitializeCanvas(ISceneTransitionContext context)
+        {
+            if (loadedScenes.TryGetValue(context.SceneTransitionDiff.NextMainSceneId, out var scene)
+                && scene is ICanvasSceneBase canvasSceneBase)
+            {
+                canvasSceneBase.InitializeCanvas(context.SceneCameraManager.UICamera);
+            }
+        }
+
+        async UniTask IMainSceneManager.Enter(ISceneTransitionContext context, CancellationToken cancelToken)
+        {
+            if (loadedScenes.TryGetValue(context.SceneTransitionDiff.NextMainSceneId, out var scene))
+            {
+                await scene.Enter(context, cancelToken);
+            }
+        }
+
+        async UniTask IMainSceneManager.Leave(ISceneTransitionContext context, CancellationToken cancelToken)
+        {
+            if (context.SceneTransitionDiff.CurrentMainSceneId != null
+                && loadedScenes.TryGetValue(context.SceneTransitionDiff.CurrentMainSceneId, out var scene))
+            {
+                await scene.Leave(context, cancelToken);
+            }
+        }
+
+        void IMainSceneManager.ResetInAnimation(ISceneTransitionContext context)
+        {
+            if (loadedScenes.TryGetValue(context.SceneTransitionDiff.NextMainSceneId, out var scene))
+            {
+                scene.ResetInAnimation(context);
+            }
+        }
+
+        async UniTask IMainSceneManager.PlayInAnimation(ISceneTransitionContext context)
+        {
+            if (loadedScenes.TryGetValue(context.SceneTransitionDiff.NextMainSceneId, out var scene))
+            {
+                await scene.PlayInAnimation(context);
+            }
+        }
+
+        async UniTask IMainSceneManager.PlayOutAnimation(ISceneTransitionContext context)
+        {
+            if (context.SceneTransitionDiff.CurrentMainSceneId != null
+                && loadedScenes.TryGetValue(context.SceneTransitionDiff.CurrentMainSceneId, out var scene))
+            {
+                await scene.PlayOutAnimation(context);
+            }
+        }
+
+        async UniTask IMainSceneManager.SaveSceneState(ISceneTransitionContext context, CancellationToken cancelToken)
+        {
+            if (context.SceneTransitionDiff.CurrentMainSceneId != null
+                && loadedScenes.TryGetValue(context.SceneTransitionDiff.CurrentMainSceneId, out var scene))
+            {
+                await scene.SaveSceneState(cancelToken);
+            }
+        }
+
+        async UniTask IMainSceneManager.Load(ISceneTransitionContext context)
+        {
+            if (context.SceneTransitionDiff.IsInnerGroupTransition)
+            {
+                return;
+            }
+
+            using (enqueueParentLifetimeScope.Invoke())
+            {
+                var loadOperations = context.SceneTransitionDiff.LoadMainSceneIds
+                    .Select(sceneId => (sceneId, ops: UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.LoadSceneAsync(sceneId.Name, LoadSceneMode.Additive)))
+                    .ToArray();
+
+                await UniTask.WhenAll(loadOperations.Select(x => UniTask.WaitUntil(() => x.ops.progress >= 0.9f)));
+
+                foreach (var loadOperation in loadOperations)
+                {
+                    loadOperation.ops.allowSceneActivation = true;
+                }
+
+                var scenes = await UniTask.WhenAll(loadOperations.Select(async x =>
+                {
+                    await UniTask.WaitUntil(() =>
+                    {
+                        var s = UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.GetSceneByName(x.sceneId.Name);
+                        return s.IsValid() && s.isLoaded;
+                    });
+
+                    var scene = FindSceneBase(x.sceneId);
+                    await scene.OnLoad();
+                    await x.ops.ToUniTask();
+                    return scene;
+                }));
+
+                foreach (var scene in scenes)
+                {
+                    loadedScenes.Add(scene.MainSceneId, scene);
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+        async UniTask IMainSceneManager.Unload(ISceneTransitionContext context)
+        {
+            if (context.SceneTransitionDiff.IsInnerGroupTransition)
+            {
+                return;
+            }
+
+            var unloadTargetMainScenes = loadedScenes
+                .Where(loadedScene => context.SceneTransitionDiff.UnloadMainSceneIds.Contains(loadedScene.Key))
+                .ToArray();
+
+            await UniTask.WhenAll(unloadTargetMainScenes.Select(s => s.Value.OnUnload()));
+            await UniTask.WhenAll(unloadTargetMainScenes.Select(s => UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.UnloadSceneAsync(s.Key.Name).ToUniTask()));
+
+            foreach (var unloadTargetMainScene in unloadTargetMainScenes)
+            {
+                loadedScenes.Remove(unloadTargetMainScene.Key);
+            }
+        }
+
+        void IMainSceneManager.OnSceneTransitionFinished(ISceneTransitionContext context)
+        {
+            if (loadedScenes.TryGetValue(context.SceneTransitionDiff.NextMainSceneId, out var scene))
+            {
+                scene.OnSceneTransitionFinished(context.SceneTransitionDiff);
+            }
+        }
+
+        async UniTask IMainSceneManager.PreReboot()
+        {
+            foreach (var loadedScene in loadedScenes)
+            {
+                if (loadedScene.Value.isActiveAndEnabled)
+                {
+                    await loadedScene.Value.SaveSceneState(CancellationToken.None);
+                }
+            }
+
+            loadedScenes.Clear();
+        }
+
+        static MainSceneBase FindSceneBase(MainSceneId mainSceneId)
+        {
+            try
+            {
+                return UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager
+                    .GetSceneByName(mainSceneId.Name)
+                    .GetRootGameObjects()
+                    .Select(x => x.GetComponent<MainSceneBase>())
+                    .First(x => x != null);
+            }
+            catch (InvalidOperationException)
+            {
+                LHLogger.LogError("[SceneGroup] MainSceneBase NotFound\n" +
+                                  "To add a scene, add it to UnityEditor and place a GameObject that inherits MainSceneBase at the root.");
+                throw;
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}

+                .SelectMany(x => x.GetSceneCameraList() ?? Array.Empty<ISceneCamera>())
+                .ToArray();
+        }
+
+        void IModuleSceneManager.ResetAnimation(ISceneTransitionContext context)
+        {
+            foreach (var targetAnimation in loadedSceneModules.Where(x => context.SceneTransitionDiff.NextSceneGroup.SceneModuleIds.Contains(x.ModuleSceneId)))
+            {
+                targetAnimation.ResetInAnimation(context);
+            }
+        }
+
+        async UniTask IModuleSceneManager.PlayInAnimation(ISceneTransitionContext context)
+        {
+            await UniTask.WhenAll(loadedSceneModules
+                .Where(x => context.SceneTransitionDiff.NextSceneGroup.SceneModuleIds.Contains(x.ModuleSceneId))
+                .Select(x => x.PlayInAnimation(context)));
+        }
+
+        async UniTask IModuleSceneManager.PlayOutAnimation(ISceneTransitionContext context)
+        {
+            if (context.SceneTransitionDiff.CurrentSceneGroup == null)
+            {
+                return;
+            }
+
+            await UniTask.WhenAll(loadedSceneModules
+                .Where(x => context.SceneTransitionDiff.CurrentSceneGroup.SceneModuleIds.Contains(x.ModuleSceneId))
+                .Select(x => x.PlayOutAnimation(context)));
+        }
+
+        async UniTask IModuleSceneManager.Load(ISceneTransitionContext context)
+        {
+            if (!context.SceneTransitionDiff.LoadSceneModuleIds.Any())
+            {
+                return;
+            }
+
+            using (enqueueParentLifetimeScope.Invoke())
+            {
+                var loadOperations = context.SceneTransitionDiff.LoadSceneModuleIds
+                    .Select(sceneId => (sceneId, ops: UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.LoadSceneAsync(sceneId.Name, LoadSceneMode.Additive)))
+                    .ToArray();
+
+                await UniTask.WhenAll(loadOperations.Select(x => UniTask.WaitUntil(() => x.ops.progress >= 0.9f)));
+
+                foreach (var loadOperation in loadOperations)
+                {
+                    loadOperation.ops.allowSceneActivation = true;
+                }
+
+                var scenes = await UniTask.WhenAll(loadOperations.Select(async x =>
+                {
+                    await UniTask.WaitUntil(() =>
+                    {
+                        var s = UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.GetSceneByName(x.sceneId.Name);
+                        return s.IsValid() && s.isLoaded;
+                    });
+
+                    var scene = FindSceneBase(x.sceneId);
+                    await scene.OnLoad();
+                    await x.ops.ToUniTask();
+                    return scene;
+                }));
+
+                loadedSceneModules.AddRange(scenes);
+            }
+        }
+
+        async UniTask IModuleSceneManager.Unload(ISceneTransitionContext context)
+        {
+            if (!context.SceneTransitionDiff.UnloadSceneModuleIds.Any())
+            {
+                return;
+            }
+
+            var unloadSceneModules = loadedSceneModules
+                .Where(x => context.SceneTransitionDiff.UnloadSceneModuleIds.Contains(x.ModuleSceneId))
+                .ToArray();
+
+            await UniTask.WhenAll(unloadSceneModules.Select(s => s.OnUnload()));
+            await UniTask.WhenAll(unloadSceneModules.Select(s => UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.UnloadSceneAsync(s.ModuleSceneId.Name).ToUniTask()));
+
+            foreach (var unloadSceneModule in unloadSceneModules)
+            {
+                loadedSceneModules.Remove(unloadSceneModule);
+            }
+        }
+
+        async UniTask IModuleSceneManager.Enter(ISceneTransitionContext context, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
+        {
+            await UniTask.WhenAll(loadedSceneModules
+                .Where(x => context.SceneTransitionDiff.NextSceneGroup.SceneModuleIds.Contains(x.ModuleSceneId))
+                .Select(x => x.Enter(context, cancellationToken)));
+        }
+
+        async UniTask IModuleSceneManager.Leave(ISceneTransitionContext context, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
+        {
+            if (context.SceneTransitionDiff.CurrentSceneGroup == null)
+            {
+                return;
+            }
+
+            await UniTask.WhenAll(loadedSceneModules
+                .Where(x => context.SceneTransitionDiff.CurrentSceneGroup.SceneModuleIds.Contains(x.ModuleSceneId))
+                .Select(x => x.Leave(context, cancellationToken)));
+        }
+
+        void IModuleSceneManager.InitializeCanvas(ISceneTransitionContext context)
+        {
+            foreach (var sceneModule in loadedSceneModules)
+            {
+                if (context.SceneTransitionDiff.LoadSceneModuleIds.Contains(sceneModule.ModuleSceneId)
+                    && sceneModule is ICanvasSceneBase canvasSceneModule)
+                {
+                    canvasSceneModule.InitializeCanvas(context.SceneCameraManager.UICamera);
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+        void IModuleSceneManager.OnSceneTransitionFinished(ISceneTransitionContext context)
+        {
+            foreach (var sceneModule in loadedSceneModules)
+            {
+                if (context.SceneTransitionDiff.NextSceneGroup.SceneModuleIds.Contains(sceneModule.ModuleSceneId))
+                {
+                    sceneModule.OnSceneTransitionFinished(context.SceneTransitionDiff);
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+        UniTask IModuleSceneManager.PreReboot()
+        {
+            loadedSceneModules.Clear();
+            return UniTask.CompletedTask;
+        }
+
+        static ModuleSceneBase FindSceneBase(ModuleSceneId moduleSceneId)
+        {
+            try
+            {
+                return UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager
+                    .GetSceneByName(moduleSceneId.Name)
+                    .GetRootGameObjects()
+                    .Select(x => x.GetComponent<ModuleSceneBase>())
+                    .First(x => x != null);
+            }
+            catch (InvalidOperationException)
+            {
+                LHLogger.LogError($"[ModuleSceneManager] SceneModule NotFound {moduleSceneId}");
+                throw;
+            }
+        }
+    }

+# task_004_debug fix done
+
+## 修正内容
+
+- `Launcher.TransitionNextScene()` を `sceneManager.TransitionScene(new WorldScene.WorldTransitionData())` に戻し、Lighthouse の遷移パイプラインを通すよう修正。
+- `Launcher.LaunchProcess()` に 5 Config Repository の `UniTask.WhenAll` ロードを復元。
+- `Launcher` コンストラクタに `IWorldConfigRepository` / `IInnConfigRepository` / `IAdventurerConfigRepository` / `IMonsterConfigRepository` / `IDungeonConfigRepository` の注入を復元。
+- `AddressableAssetSettings.asset` の `m_ActivePlayerDataBuilderIndex` を `0` に変更。
+- Unity Editor 上の Addressables Play Mode builder も `ActivePlayModeDataBuilderIndex = 0` に設定。
+- Config Repository は Addressables を使用したロードに戻し、PlayMode で await が戻らない経路を避けるため `WaitForCompletion()` で取得して `ToData()` をキャッシュする実装に修正。

+- `WorldLifetimeScope` で `WorldScene` を `RegisterComponentInHierarchy` し、`WorldScene` の `[Inject]` が実行されるよう修正。
+- `ScreenStackBackgroundInputBlocker` を `ScreenStackScene` 配下に生成し、`ScreenStack` の root count が増えないよう修正。
+

+  - `WarningCount: 0`

+using System;
+using System.Collections.Generic;
+using System.Linq;
+using System.Threading;
+using Cysharp.Threading.Tasks;
+using Lighthouse;
+using Lighthouse.Scene;
+using Lighthouse.Scene.SceneBase;
+using Lighthouse.Scene.SceneCamera;
+using UnityEngine.SceneManagement;
+
+namespace DungeonInn.Runtime.Scripts.Core
+{
+    public sealed class ProductMainSceneManager : IMainSceneManager
+    {
+        readonly Dictionary<MainSceneId, MainSceneBase> loadedScenes = new();
+
+        Func<IDisposable> enqueueParentLifetimeScope;
+
+        void IMainSceneManager.SetEnqueueParentLifetimeScope(Func<IDisposable> enqueueParentLifetimeScope)
+        {
+            this.enqueueParentLifetimeScope = enqueueParentLifetimeScope;
+        }
+
+        ISceneCamera[] IMainSceneManager.GetSceneCameraList(SceneTransitionDiff sceneTransitionDiff)
+        {
+            return loadedScenes.TryGetValue(sceneTransitionDiff.NextMainSceneId, out var scene)
+                ? scene.GetSceneCameraList()
+                : Array.Empty<ISceneCamera>();
+        }
+
+        void IMainSceneManager.InitializeCanvas(ISceneTransitionContext context)
+        {
+            if (loadedScenes.TryGetValue(context.SceneTransitionDiff.NextMainSceneId, out var scene)
+                && scene is ICanvasSceneBase canvasSceneBase)
+            {
+                canvasSceneBase.InitializeCanvas(context.SceneCameraManager.UICamera);
+            }
+        }
+
+        async UniTask IMainSceneManager.Enter(ISceneTransitionContext context, CancellationToken cancelToken)
+        {
+            if (loadedScenes.TryGetValue(context.SceneTransitionDiff.NextMainSceneId, out var scene))
+            {
+                await scene.Enter(context, cancelToken);
+            }
+        }
+
+        async UniTask IMainSceneManager.Leave(ISceneTransitionContext context, CancellationToken cancelToken)
+        {
+            if (context.SceneTransitionDiff.CurrentMainSceneId != null
+                && loadedScenes.TryGetValue(context.SceneTransitionDiff.CurrentMainSceneId, out var scene))
+            {
+                await scene.Leave(context, cancelToken);
+            }
+        }
+
+        void IMainSceneManager.ResetInAnimation(ISceneTransitionContext context)
+        {
+            if (loadedScenes.TryGetValue(context.SceneTransitionDiff.NextMainSceneId, out var scene))
+            {
+                scene.ResetInAnimation(context);
+            }
+        }
+
+        async UniTask IMainSceneManager.PlayInAnimation(ISceneTransitionContext context)
+        {
+            if (loadedScenes.TryGetValue(context.SceneTransitionDiff.NextMainSceneId, out var scene))
+            {
+                await scene.PlayInAnimation(context);
+            }
+        }
+
+        async UniTask IMainSceneManager.PlayOutAnimation(ISceneTransitionContext context)
+        {
+            if (context.SceneTransitionDiff.CurrentMainSceneId != null
+                && loadedScenes.TryGetValue(context.SceneTransitionDiff.CurrentMainSceneId, out var scene))
+            {
+                await scene.PlayOutAnimation(context);
+            }
+        }
+
+        async UniTask IMainSceneManager.SaveSceneState(ISceneTransitionContext context, CancellationToken cancelToken)
+        {
+            if (context.SceneTransitionDiff.CurrentMainSceneId != null
+                && loadedScenes.TryGetValue(context.SceneTransitionDiff.CurrentMainSceneId, out var scene))
+            {
+                await scene.SaveSceneState(cancelToken);
+            }
+        }
+
+        async UniTask IMainSceneManager.Load(ISceneTransitionContext context)
+        {
+            if (context.SceneTransitionDiff.IsInnerGroupTransition)
+            {
+                return;
+            }
+
+            using (enqueueParentLifetimeScope.Invoke())
+            {
+                var loadOperations = context.SceneTransitionDiff.LoadMainSceneIds
+                    .Select(sceneId => (sceneId, ops: UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.LoadSceneAsync(sceneId.Name, LoadSceneMode.Additive)))
+                    .ToArray();
+
+                await UniTask.WhenAll(loadOperations.Select(x => UniTask.WaitUntil(() => x.ops.progress >= 0.9f)));
+
+                foreach (var loadOperation in loadOperations)
+                {
+                    loadOperation.ops.allowSceneActivation = true;
+                }
+
+                var scenes = await UniTask.WhenAll(loadOperations.Select(async x =>
+                {
+                    await UniTask.WaitUntil(() =>
+                    {
+                        var s = UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.GetSceneByName(x.sceneId.Name);
+                        return s.IsValid() && s.isLoaded;
+                    });
+
+                    var scene = FindSceneBase(x.sceneId);
+                    await scene.OnLoad();
+                    await x.ops.ToUniTask();
+                    return scene;
+                }));
+
+                foreach (var scene in scenes)
+                {
+                    loadedScenes.Add(scene.MainSceneId, scene);
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+        async UniTask IMainSceneManager.Unload(ISceneTransitionContext context)
+        {
+            if (context.SceneTransitionDiff.IsInnerGroupTransition)
+            {
+                return;
+            }
+
+            var unloadTargetMainScenes = loadedScenes
+                .Where(loadedScene => context.SceneTransitionDiff.UnloadMainSceneIds.Contains(loadedScene.Key))
+                .ToArray();
+
+            await UniTask.WhenAll(unloadTargetMainScenes.Select(s => s.Value.OnUnload()));
+            await UniTask.WhenAll(unloadTargetMainScenes.Select(s => UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.UnloadSceneAsync(s.Key.Name).ToUniTask()));
+
+            foreach (var unloadTargetMainScene in unloadTargetMainScenes)
+            {
+                loadedScenes.Remove(unloadTargetMainScene.Key);
+            }
+        }
+
+        void IMainSceneManager.OnSceneTransitionFinished(ISceneTransitionContext context)
+        {
+            if (loadedScenes.TryGetValue(context.SceneTransitionDiff.NextMainSceneId, out var scene))
+            {
+                scene.OnSceneTransitionFinished(context.SceneTransitionDiff);
+            }
+        }
+
+        async UniTask IMainSceneManager.PreReboot()
+        {
+            foreach (var loadedScene in loadedScenes)
+            {
+                if (loadedScene.Value.isActiveAndEnabled)
+                {
+                    await loadedScene.Value.SaveSceneState(CancellationToken.None);
+                }
+            }
+
+            loadedScenes.Clear();
+        }
+
+        static MainSceneBase FindSceneBase(MainSceneId mainSceneId)
+        {
+            try
+            {
+                return UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager
+                    .GetSceneByName(mainSceneId.Name)
+                    .GetRootGameObjects()
+                    .Select(x => x.GetComponent<MainSceneBase>())
+                    .First(x => x != null);
+            }
+            catch (InvalidOperationException)
+            {
+                LHLogger.LogError("[SceneGroup] MainSceneBase NotFound\n" +
+                                  "To add a scene, add it to UnityEditor and place a GameObject that inherits MainSceneBase at the root.");
+                throw;
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}

+using System;
+using System.Collections.Generic;
+using System.Linq;
+using System.Threading;
+using Cysharp.Threading.Tasks;
+using Lighthouse;
+using Lighthouse.Scene;
+using Lighthouse.Scene.SceneBase;
+using Lighthouse.Scene.SceneCamera;
+using UnityEngine.SceneManagement;
+
+namespace DungeonInn.Runtime.Scripts.Core
+{
+    public sealed class ProductModuleSceneManager : IModuleSceneManager
+    {
+        readonly List<ModuleSceneBase> loadedSceneModules = new();
+
+        Func<IDisposable> enqueueParentLifetimeScope;
+
+        void IModuleSceneManager.SetEnqueueParentLifetimeScope(Func<IDisposable> enqueueParentLifetimeScope)
+        {
+            this.enqueueParentLifetimeScope = enqueueParentLifetimeScope;
+        }
+
+        ISceneCamera[] IModuleSceneManager.GetSceneCameraList(ModuleSceneId[] requestSceneModuleIds)
+        {
+            return loadedSceneModules
+                .Where(s => requestSceneModuleIds.Contains(s.ModuleSceneId))
+                .SelectMany(x => x.GetSceneCameraList() ?? Array.Empty<ISceneCamera>())
+                .ToArray();
+        }
+
+        void IModuleSceneManager.ResetAnimation(ISceneTransitionContext context)
+        {
+            foreach (var targetAnimation in loadedSceneModules.Where(x => context.SceneTransitionDiff.NextSceneGroup.SceneModuleIds.Contains(x.ModuleSceneId)))
+            {
+                targetAnimation.ResetInAnimation(context);
+            }
+        }
+
+        async UniTask IModuleSceneManager.PlayInAnimation(ISceneTransitionContext context)
+        {
+            await UniTask.WhenAll(loadedSceneModules
+                .Where(x => context.SceneTransitionDiff.NextSceneGroup.SceneModuleIds.Contains(x.ModuleSceneId))
+                .Select(x => x.PlayInAnimation(context)));
+        }
+
+        async UniTask IModuleSceneManager.PlayOutAnimation(ISceneTransitionContext context)
+        {
+            if (context.SceneTransitionDiff.CurrentSceneGroup == null)
+            {
+                return;
+            }
+
+            await UniTask.WhenAll(loadedSceneModules
+                .Where(x => context.SceneTransitionDiff.CurrentSceneGroup.SceneModuleIds.Contains(x.ModuleSceneId))
+                .Select(x => x.PlayOutAnimation(context)));
+        }
+
+        async UniTask IModuleSceneManager.Load(ISceneTransitionContext context)
+        {
+            if (!context.SceneTransitionDiff.LoadSceneModuleIds.Any())
+            {
+                return;
+            }
+
+            using (enqueueParentLifetimeScope.Invoke())
+            {
+                var loadOperations = context.SceneTransitionDiff.LoadSceneModuleIds
+                    .Select(sceneId => (sceneId, ops: UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.LoadSceneAsync(sceneId.Name, LoadSceneMode.Additive)))
+                    .ToArray();
+
+                await UniTask.WhenAll(loadOperations.Select(x => UniTask.WaitUntil(() => x.ops.progress >= 0.9f)));
+
+                foreach (var loadOperation in loadOperations)
+                {
+                    loadOperation.ops.allowSceneActivation = true;
+                }
+
+                var scenes = await UniTask.WhenAll(loadOperations.Select(async x =>
+                {
+                    await UniTask.WaitUntil(() =>
+                    {
+                        var s = UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.GetSceneByName(x.sceneId.Name);
+                        return s.IsValid() && s.isLoaded;
+                    });
+
+                    var scene = FindSceneBase(x.sceneId);
+                    await scene.OnLoad();
+                    await x.ops.ToUniTask();
+                    return scene;
+                }));
+
+                loadedSceneModules.AddRange(scenes);
+            }
+        }
+
+        async UniTask IModuleSceneManager.Unload(ISceneTransitionContext context)
+        {
+            if (!context.SceneTransitionDiff.UnloadSceneModuleIds.Any())
+            {
+                return;
+            }
+
+            var unloadSceneModules = loadedSceneModules
+                .Where(x => context.SceneTransitionDiff.UnloadSceneModuleIds.Contains(x.ModuleSceneId))
+                .ToArray();
+
+            await UniTask.WhenAll(unloadSceneModules.Select(s => s.OnUnload()));
+            await UniTask.WhenAll(unloadSceneModules.Select(s => UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.UnloadSceneAsync(s.ModuleSceneId.Name).ToUniTask()));
+
+            foreach (var unloadSceneModule in unloadSceneModules)
+            {
+                loadedSceneModules.Remove(unloadSceneModule);
+            }
+        }
+
+        async UniTask IModuleSceneManager.Enter(ISceneTransitionContext context, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
+        {
+            await UniTask.WhenAll(loadedSceneModules
+                .Where(x => context.SceneTransitionDiff.NextSceneGroup.SceneModuleIds.Contains(x.ModuleSceneId))
+                .Select(x => x.Enter(context, cancellationToken)));
+        }
+
+        async UniTask IModuleSceneManager.Leave(ISceneTransitionContext context, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
+        {
+            if (context.SceneTransitionDiff.CurrentSceneGroup == null)
+            {
+                return;
+            }
+
+            await UniTask.WhenAll(loadedSceneModules
+                .Where(x => context.SceneTransitionDiff.CurrentSceneGroup.SceneModuleIds.Contains(x.ModuleSceneId))
+                .Select(x => x.Leave(context, cancellationToken)));
+        }
+
+        void IModuleSceneManager.InitializeCanvas(ISceneTransitionContext context)
+        {
+            foreach (var sceneModule in loadedSceneModules)
+            {
+                if (context.SceneTransitionDiff.LoadSceneModuleIds.Contains(sceneModule.ModuleSceneId)
+                    && sceneModule is ICanvasSceneBase canvasSceneModule)
+                {
+                    canvasSceneModule.InitializeCanvas(context.SceneCameraManager.UICamera);
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+        void IModuleSceneManager.OnSceneTransitionFinished(ISceneTransitionContext context)
+        {
+            foreach (var sceneModule in loadedSceneModules)
+            {
+                if (context.SceneTransitionDiff.NextSceneGroup.SceneModuleIds.Contains(sceneModule.ModuleSceneId))
+                {
+                    sceneModule.OnSceneTransitionFinished(context.SceneTransitionDiff);
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+        UniTask IModuleSceneManager.PreReboot()
+        {
+            loadedSceneModules.Clear();
+            return UniTask.CompletedTask;
+        }
+
+        static ModuleSceneBase FindSceneBase(ModuleSceneId moduleSceneId)
+        {
+            try
+            {
+                return UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager
+                    .GetSceneByName(moduleSceneId.Name)
+                    .GetRootGameObjects()
+                    .Select(x => x.GetComponent<ModuleSceneBase>())
+                    .First(x => x != null);
+            }
+            catch (InvalidOperationException)
+            {
+                LHLogger.LogError($"[ModuleSceneManager] SceneModule NotFound {moduleSceneId}");
+                throw;
+            }
+        }
+    }

+# task_004_debug fix done

+## 修正内容
+
+- `Launcher.TransitionNextScene()` を `sceneManager.TransitionScene(new WorldScene.WorldTransitionData())` に戻し、Lighthouse の遷移パイプラインを通すよう修正。
+- `Launcher.LaunchProcess()` に 5 Config Repository の `UniTask.WhenAll` ロードを復元。
+- `Launcher` コンストラクタに `IWorldConfigRepository` / `IInnConfigRepository` / `IAdventurerConfigRepository` / `IMonsterConfigRepository` / `IDungeonConfigRepository` の注入を復元。
+- `AddressableAssetSettings.asset` の `m_ActivePlayerDataBuilderIndex` を `0` に変更。
+- Unity Editor 上の Addressables Play Mode builder も `ActivePlayModeDataBuilderIndex = 0` に設定。
+- Config Repository は Addressables を使用したロードに戻し、PlayMode で await が戻らない経路を避けるため `WaitForCompletion()` で取得して `ToData()` をキャッシュする実装に修正。
+- Lighthouse の `AsyncOperation` await が MainScene load 完了後に戻らず ModuleScene load に進まないため、PackageCache は触らず `ProductMainSceneManager` / `ProductModuleSceneManager` を追加し、`AsyncOperation` 完了待ちを `ToUniTask()` にした実装を登録。
+- `WorldLifetimeScope` で `WorldScene` を `RegisterComponentInHierarchy` し、`WorldScene` の `[Inject]` が実行されるよう修正。
+- `ScreenStackBackgroundInputBlocker` を `ScreenStackScene` 配下に生成し、`ScreenStack` の root count が増えないよう修正。
+
+## 確認
+
+- `uloop.cmd compile --project-path Client`
+  - `Success: true`
+  - `ErrorCount: 0`
+  - `WarningCount: 0`
+
+## 残確認
+
+- 最終 PlayMode シーン確認の直前に PowerShell プロセス自体が `-1073741502` で起動失敗する状態になったため、以下は未完了。
+  - `uloop get-logs` Error 0 の最終再確認
+  - `execute-dynamic-code` の `World[2] ScreenStack[1] HUD[1]` 最終再確認
+
+直前の切り分けでは、Addressables Play Mode builder 設定後に `World[2]` までは確認済み。その後、Lighthouse MainSceneManager の `AsyncOperation` await 停止を修正するため `ProductMainSceneManager` / `ProductModuleSceneManager` を追加し、コンパイル 0 まで確認済み。

# task_review_001: コードベース全体レビュー

## 目的

現時点のコードベースを以下の観点でレビューし、問題点をすべて列挙してください。
実装作業は行わない。問題の報告のみ。

## レビュー対象ディレクトリ

```
Client/Assets/DungeonInn/Runtime/Scripts/
```

## レビュー観点

### 1. AGENTS.md の禁止事項チェック

以下をコード全体で grep して違反を探す:

- `Addressables.LoadAssetAsync` の直接呼び出し
- `Resources.Load` の使用
- `SceneManager.LoadScene` / `LoadSceneAsync` の直接呼び出し（Launcher.cs の Reboot() は意図的な例外として許容）
- `Task` / `ValueTask` の使用（`UniTask` 以外の非同期）
- `UnityEngine.UI.Button` の直接使用（`LHButton` 以外）
- `Keyboard.current` / `Mouse.current` の直接ポーリング
- `Input.GetKey` / `Input.GetAxis` の使用
- `WaitForCompletion()` の使用

### 2. アーキテクチャ依存ルールチェック（docs/domain-design.md 参照）

```
Domain 層   → Unity 依存禁止、Lighthouse 依存禁止、UniTask 禁止
Application 層 → Unity 禁止、Lighthouse 禁止、UniTask 必須
Infrastructure 層 → IAssetScope のみ許可
View 層     → 制限なし
```

- Domain 層のファイル（Scripts/Domain/）に Unity / Lighthouse の using がないか
- MonoBehaviour が Domain 層にないか

### 3. namespace チェック

- グローバル namespace のクラスがないか（すべてのクラスは namespace を持つべき）
- ファイルパスと namespace が一致しているか

### 4. domain-design.md との整合性チェック

docs/domain-design.md に定義されたクラス・インターフェース・メソッドシグネチャと
実際の実装が一致しているか確認する。

主な確認対象:
- InnLand: PurchaseParcel, CanPurchaseAt, GetRoomContaining, AddFunds, TrySpendFunds, AddBeds
- Room: OpenDoor, CanPlaceBedAt, PlaceBed, RemoveBed, IsWall, Contains, Density
- CharacterBase: TakeDamage, Heal, IsAlive
- AdventurerCharacter: UpdateSatisfaction, TransitionState
- InnFeeCalculator: Calculate シグネチャ
- SatisfactionCalculator: Calculate シグネチャ

### 5. その他気になる問題

上記以外で気になった設計上・実装上の問題があれば報告する。

### 1. Addressables 逶ｴ謗･蜻ｼ縺ｳ蜃ｺ縺礼ｦ∵ｭ｢

```csharp
// NG: 邨ｶ蟇ｾ遖∵ｭ｢
Addressables.LoadAssetAsync<T>(address);
Addressables.LoadAssetAsync<T>(address).WaitForCompletion(); // WaitForCompletion 繧らｦ∵ｭ｢
Resources.Load<T>(path); // Resources.Load 繧らｦ∵ｭ｢
```

**逅・罰**: Lighthouse 繝輔Ξ繝ｼ繝繝ｯ繝ｼ繧ｯ縺・`IAssetScope` 縺ｧ ref-count 繧堤ｮ｡逅・＠縺ｦ縺・ｋ縺溘ａ縲∫峩謗･蜻ｼ縺ｳ蜃ｺ縺吶→隗｣謾ｾ貍上ｌ繝ｻ莠碁㍾隗｣謾ｾ縺檎匱逕溘☆繧九ＡWaitForCompletion` 縺ｯ繝｡繧､繝ｳ繧ｹ繝ｬ繝・ラ繧偵ヶ繝ｭ繝・け縺励ヵ繝ｪ繝ｼ繧ｺ繧貞ｼ輔″襍ｷ縺薙☆縲・
**豁｣縺励＞繝代ち繝ｼ繝ｳ**:
```csharp
using Cysharp.Threading.Tasks;
using LighthouseExtends.Addressable;
using VContainer;

public class WorldConfigRepository : IWorldConfigRepository
{
    readonly IAssetManager assetManager;
    WorldConfigData cached;

    [Inject]
    public WorldConfigRepository(IAssetManager assetManager)
    {
        this.assetManager = assetManager;
    }

    public async UniTask<WorldConfigData> LoadAsync()
    {
        if (cached != null) return cached;
        using var scope = assetManager.CreateScope();           // 繧ｹ繧ｳ繝ｼ繝嶺ｽ懈・
        var handle = await scope.LoadAsync<WorldConfigSO>(address); // 髱槫酔譛溘Ο繝ｼ繝・        cached = handle.Asset.ToData();                         // 繝・・繧ｿ螟画鋤
        return cached;
        // 繧ｹ繧ｳ繝ｼ繝励・ using 縺ｧ閾ｪ蜍戊ｧ｣謾ｾ縺輔ｌ繧・    }
}
```

`IAssetManager` 縺ｯ VContainer 縺ｮ `[Inject]` 縺ｧ繧ｳ繝ｳ繧ｹ繝医Λ繧ｯ繧ｿ豕ｨ蜈･縺吶ｋ縲・

`ISceneManager` 縺ｯ VContainer 縺ｮ `[Inject]` 縺ｧ繧ｳ繝ｳ繧ｹ繝医Λ繧ｯ繧ｿ豕ｨ蜈･縺吶ｋ縲・

## Lighthouse 繝輔Ξ繝ｼ繝繝ｯ繝ｼ繧ｯ讎りｦ・
縺薙・繝励Ο繧ｸ繧ｧ繧ｯ繝医・ **Lighthouse**・・Container / UniTask / R3 繝吶・繧ｹ縺ｮ Unity 繝輔Ξ繝ｼ繝繝ｯ繝ｼ繧ｯ・峨ｒ菴ｿ逕ｨ縺励※縺・ｋ縲ゆｻ･荳九・謚ｽ雎｡縺梧署萓帙＆繧後※縺・ｋ縲・
### 繧ｷ繝ｼ繝ｳ邂｡逅・
| 讖溯・ | 繧ｯ繝ｩ繧ｹ / 繧､繝ｳ繧ｿ繝ｼ繝輔ぉ繝ｼ繧ｹ |
|------|--------------------------|
| 繧ｷ繝ｼ繝ｳ驕ｷ遘ｻ | `ISceneManager.TransitionScene()` / `BackScene()` |
| 繝｡繧､繝ｳ繧ｷ繝ｼ繝ｳ蝓ｺ蠎・| `MainSceneBase<TTransitionData>` |
| 繝｢繧ｸ繝･繝ｼ繝ｫ繧ｷ繝ｼ繝ｳ蝓ｺ蠎・| `ModuleSceneBase` |
| Canvas 莉倥″繧ｷ繝ｼ繝ｳ蝓ｺ蠎・| `CanvasMainSceneBase<T>` / `CanvasModuleSceneBase` |

MainScene 縺ｮ繧ｪ繝ｼ繝舌・繝ｩ繧､繝峨・繧､繝ｳ繝・
- `OnLoad()` 竊・繧｢繧ｻ繝・ヨ隱ｭ縺ｿ霎ｼ縺ｿ蠕後・DI 蜑阪・蛻晄悄蛹・- `OnSetup()` 竊・蛻晏屓 Enter 譎ゅ・縺ｿ
- `OnEnter()` 竊・繧ｷ繝ｼ繝ｳ蜈･蝣ｴ繝ｭ繧ｸ繝・け
- `OnLeave()` 竊・繧ｷ繝ｼ繝ｳ騾蝣ｴ繝ｭ繧ｸ繝・け
- `GetSceneCameraList()` 竊・縺薙・繧ｷ繝ｼ繝ｳ縺梧戟縺､繧ｫ繝｡繝ｩ繝ｪ繧ｹ繝医ｒ霑斐☆・亥ｿ・医が繝ｼ繝舌・繝ｩ繧､繝会ｼ・
### 繧｢繝峨Ξ繧ｵ繝悶Ν

```
IAssetManager 竊・assetManager.CreateScope() 竊・IAssetScope
IAssetScope:
  LoadAsync<T>(address)        竊・蜊倅ｸ繧｢繧ｻ繝・ヨ・磯撼蜷梧悄・・  LoadAsync<T>(addresses)      竊・隍・焚繧｢繝峨Ξ繧ｹ荳諡ｬ
  LoadByLabelAsync<T>(label)   竊・繝ｩ繝吶Ν荳諡ｬ
```

繧｢繧ｻ繝・ヨ縺ｯ `using var scope = assetManager.CreateScope()` 縺ｮ繧ｹ繧ｳ繝ｼ繝怜・縺ｧ縺ｮ縺ｿ譛牙柑縲ゅせ繧ｳ繝ｼ繝怜､悶〒縺ｮ菫晄戟縺悟ｿ・ｦ√↑蝣ｴ蜷医・ `.ToData()` 遲峨〒蛟､蝙九↓螟画鋤縺励※繧ｭ繝｣繝・す繝･縺吶ｋ縲・
### 繧ｹ繧ｯ繝ｪ繝ｼ繝ｳ繧ｹ繧ｿ繝・け・医Δ繝ｼ繝繝ｫ・・
```
IScreenStackManager:
  Open(IScreenStackData)   竊・繝｢繝ｼ繝繝ｫ繧帝幕縺・  Close(IScreenStackData)  竊・繝｢繝ｼ繝繝ｫ繧帝哩縺倥ｋ
  ClearAll()               竊・縺吶∋縺ｦ繧ｯ繝ｪ繧｢
```

繝｢繝ｼ繝繝ｫ縺ｮ謇句虚 `Instantiate` / `Destroy` 縺ｯ遖∵ｭ｢縲・
### Input 繝ｬ繧､繝､繝ｼ

```
IInputLayerController:
  PushLayer(IInputLayer, InputActionMap)  竊・譛牙柑蛹悶＠縺ｦ繧ｹ繧ｿ繝・け縺ｫ遨阪・
  PopLayer(IInputLayer)                   竊・辟｡蜉ｹ蛹悶＠縺ｦ繧ｹ繧ｿ繝・け縺九ｉ髯､縺・```

## 1. MainScene 繧定ｿｽ蜉縺吶ｋ

### 蝓ｺ蠎輔け繝ｩ繧ｹ

`ProductCanvasMainSceneBase<TTransitionData>` 繧堤ｶ呎価縺吶ｋ縲・
```csharp
using Cysharp.Threading.Tasks;
using DungeonInn.LighthouseGenerated;
using DungeonInn.Runtime.Scripts.View.Base;
using Lighthouse.Scene;

namespace DungeonInn.Runtime.Scripts.View.Scene.MainScene.Inn
{
    public class InnScene : ProductCanvasMainSceneBase<InnScene.InnTransitionData>
    {
        // 繧ｷ繝ｼ繝ｳ ID 縺ｯ閾ｪ蜍慕函謌舌ヵ繧｡繧､繝ｫ DungeonInnMainSceneId.g.cs 縺九ｉ蜿門ｾ励☆繧・        public override MainSceneId MainSceneId => DungeonInnMainSceneId.Inn;

        // 驕ｷ遘ｻ繝・・繧ｿ縺ｯ蠢・★繧ｷ繝ｼ繝ｳ繧ｯ繝ｩ繧ｹ縺ｮ蜀・Κ繧ｯ繝ｩ繧ｹ縺ｨ縺励※螳夂ｾｩ縺吶ｋ
        public class InnTransitionData : ProductTransitionDataBase
        {
            public override MainSceneId MainSceneId => DungeonInnMainSceneId.Inn;
        }

        // 繝ｩ繧､繝輔し繧､繧ｯ繝ｫ繝輔ャ繧ｯ・亥ｿ・ｦ√↑繧ゅ・縺縺代が繝ｼ繝舌・繝ｩ繧､繝峨☆繧具ｼ・        protected override UniTask OnLoad(ISceneTransitionContext context)
        {
            // 繧｢繧ｻ繝・ヨ隱ｭ縺ｿ霎ｼ縺ｿ蠕後・DI 蜑阪・蛻晄悄蛹・            return UniTask.CompletedTask;
        }

        protected override UniTask OnSetup(ISceneTransitionContext context, CancellationToken cancelToken)
        {
            // 蛻晏屓 Enter 譎ゅ・縺ｿ蜻ｼ縺ｰ繧後ｋ荳蝗樣剞繧翫・蛻晄悄蛹・            return UniTask.CompletedTask;
        }

        protected override UniTask OnEnter(ISceneTransitionContext context, CancellationToken cancelToken)
        {
            // 繧ｷ繝ｼ繝ｳ蜈･蝣ｴ繝ｭ繧ｸ繝・け・域ｯ主屓蜻ｼ縺ｰ繧後ｋ・・            return base.OnEnter(context, cancelToken); // 蠢・★ base 繧貞他縺ｶ・・nputLayer 縺ｮ Push 縺後≠繧具ｼ・        }

        protected override UniTask OnLeave(ISceneTransitionContext context, CancellationToken cancelToken)
        {
            // 繧ｷ繝ｼ繝ｳ騾蝣ｴ繝ｭ繧ｸ繝・け
            return base.OnLeave(context, cancelToken); // 蠢・★ base 繧貞他縺ｶ・・nputLayer 縺ｮ Pop 縺後≠繧具ｼ・        }
    }
}
```

### 蠢・ｦ√↑ Unity 繧ｳ繝ｳ繝昴・繝阪Φ繝茨ｼ・unity 繧ｷ繝ｼ繝ｳ繝輔ぃ繧､繝ｫ・・

- `LHSceneTransitionAnimatorManager`・・[RequireComponent]` 縺ｧ閾ｪ蜍戊ｦ∵ｱゅ＆繧後ｋ・・

## 4. 繧ｷ繝ｼ繝ｳ縺ｫ Input 繧定ｿｽ蜉縺吶ｋ

### IInputLayer 縺ｮ螳溯｣・
```csharp
using DungeonInn.Input;
using LighthouseExtends.InputLayer;
using UnityEngine.InputSystem;

namespace DungeonInn.Runtime.Scripts.Input.Layer
{
    public class InnSceneInputLayer : IInputLayer
    {
        readonly InputActions.SceneActions sceneActions;

        public InnSceneInputLayer(InputActions inputActions)
        {
            sceneActions = inputActions.Scene;
        }

        // true 縺ｫ縺吶ｋ縺ｨ荳句ｱ､繝ｬ繧､繝､繝ｼ縺ｸ縺ｮ蜈･蜉帑ｼ晄眺繧偵☆縺ｹ縺ｦ驕ｮ譁ｭ縺吶ｋ
        public bool BlocksAllInput => false;

        public bool OnActionStarted(InputAction.CallbackContext ctx) => false;

        public bool OnActionPerformed(InputAction.CallbackContext ctx)
        {
            if (ctx.action.id == sceneActions.Back.id)
            {
                // Back 蜈･蜉帙ｒ蜃ｦ逅・＠縺溷ｴ蜷医・ true 繧定ｿ斐☆・井ｸ句ｱ､縺ｫ莨晄眺縺励↑縺・ｼ・                return true;
            }
            return false;
        }

        public bool OnActionCanceled(InputAction.CallbackContext ctx) => false;
    }
}
```

### MainScene 縺ｧ縺ｮ逋ｻ骭ｲ

`ProductCanvasMainSceneBase` 繧堤ｶ呎価縺励◆繧ｷ繝ｼ繝ｳ縺ｧ莉･荳九ｒ繧ｪ繝ｼ繝舌・繝ｩ繧､繝峨☆繧九・
```csharp
protected override IInputLayer CreateInputLayer(InputActions inputActions)
{
    return new InnSceneInputLayer(inputActions);
}

protected override InputActionMap GetInputLayerActionMap(InputActions inputActions)
{
    // Scene ActionMap 繧剃ｽｿ縺・ｴ蜷茨ｼ医ョ繝輔か繝ｫ繝茨ｼ・    return inputActions.Scene;
    // ScreenStack ActionMap 繧剃ｽｿ縺・ｴ蜷・    // return inputActions.ScreenStack;
}
```

`base.OnEnter()` / `base.OnLeave()` 縺瑚・蜍輔〒 `PushLayer` / `PopLayer` 繧貞他縺ｶ縲・**`OnEnter` / `OnLeave` 繧偵が繝ｼ繝舌・繝ｩ繧､繝峨☆繧九→縺阪・蠢・★ `base` 繧貞他縺ｶ縺薙→縲・*

## 5. 繧｢繧ｻ繝・ヨ繧帝撼蜷梧悄繝ｭ繝ｼ繝峨☆繧・

```csharp
using LighthouseExtends.Addressable;
using VContainer;

public class SomeService
{
    readonly IAssetManager assetManager;

    [Inject]
    public SomeService(IAssetManager assetManager)
    {
        this.assetManager = assetManager;
    }

    public async UniTask DoSomething()
    {
        using var scope = assetManager.CreateScope();
        var handle = await scope.LoadAsync<SomeSO>("Config/SomeKey");
        var data = handle.Asset.ToData();
        // scope 繧呈栢縺代ｋ縺ｨ繧｢繧ｻ繝・ヨ縺瑚・蜍戊ｧ｣謾ｾ縺輔ｌ繧・        // scope 螟悶〒菴ｿ縺・◆縺・ョ繝ｼ繧ｿ縺ｯ ToData() 遲峨〒蛟､蝙九↓螟画鋤縺励※縺翫￥
    }
}
```

## 6. Config Repository 繧剃ｽ懊ｋ

### 繧､繝ｳ繧ｿ繝ｼ繝輔ぉ繝ｼ繧ｹ・・omain 螻､・・
```csharp
// Domain/Inn/IInnConfigRepository.cs
using Cysharp.Threading.Tasks;

namespace DungeonInn.Domain.Inn
{
    public interface IInnConfigRepository
    {
        UniTask<InnConfigData> LoadAsync();
    }
}
```

### 螳溯｣・ｼ・nfrastructure 螻､・・
```csharp
// Infrastructure/Repository/InnConfigRepository.cs
using Cysharp.Threading.Tasks;
using DungeonInn.Domain.Inn;
using LighthouseExtends.Addressable;
using VContainer;

namespace DungeonInn.Infrastructure.Repository
{
    public class InnConfigRepository : IInnConfigRepository
    {
        readonly IAssetManager assetManager;
        InnConfigData cached;

        [Inject]
        public InnConfigRepository(IAssetManager assetManager)
        {
            this.assetManager = assetManager;
        }

        public async UniTask<InnConfigData> LoadAsync()
        {
            if (cached != null) return cached;
            using var scope = assetManager.CreateScope();
            var handle = await scope.LoadAsync<InnConfigSO>("Config/InnConfig");
            cached = handle.Asset.ToData();
            return cached;
        }
    }
}
```

### ScriptableObject・・nfrastructure 螻､・・

## 7. 譁ｰ縺励＞繧ｷ繝ｼ繝ｳ繧偵す繝ｼ繝ｳ繧ｰ繝ｫ繝ｼ繝励↓逋ｻ骭ｲ縺吶ｋ

## 8. 繧ｷ繝ｼ繝ｳ縺ｮ LifetimeScope 繧呈嶌縺・
蜷・す繝ｼ繝ｳ縺ｫ縺ｯ蟆ら畑縺ｮ LifetimeScope 繧堤畑諢上＠縲√◎縺ｮ繧ｷ繝ｼ繝ｳ蝗ｺ譛峨・繧ｳ繝ｳ繝昴・繝阪Φ繝医ｒ逋ｻ骭ｲ縺吶ｋ縲・

        {

        }
    }

```

### 豕ｨ諢・
- LifetimeScope 縺ｯ蠢・★繧ｷ繝ｼ繝ｳ蝗ｺ譛峨・ namespace 繧呈戟縺､縺薙→・医げ繝ｭ繝ｼ繝舌Ν namespace 縺ｯ遖∵ｭ｢・・- `ProductLifetimeScope`・医ご繝ｼ繝蜈ｨ菴難ｼ峨∈縺ｮ逋ｻ骭ｲ縺ｨ豺ｷ蜷後＠縺ｪ縺・％縺ｨ

## 3. 蛟､繧ｪ繝悶ず繧ｧ繧ｯ繝・
### struct / class 菴ｿ縺・・縺第婿驥・

### 4.2 Inn

#### 蝨溷慍繝ｻ驛ｨ螻九・繝吶ャ繝峨・髢｢菫・
```
InnLand
  笏懌楳笏 Rooms: List<Room>       5mﾃ・m 縺ｮ蝨溷慍繧定ｳｼ蜈･縺吶ｋ縺溘・縺ｫ Room 縺・1 縺､閾ｪ蜍慕函謌舌＆繧後ｋ
  笏・    笏懌楳笏 Beds: List<Bed>   繝励Ξ繧､繝､繝ｼ縺梧園謖√・繝・ラ繧剃ｻｻ諢丈ｽ咲ｽｮ縺ｫ驟咲ｽｮ
  笏・    笏披楳笏 DoorPositions     髫｣謗･ Room 縺ｨ縺ｮ蜈ｱ譛牙｣√↓髢九￥蜃ｺ蜈･繧雁哨
  笏懌楳笏 Funds: Money            雉・≡
  笏披楳笏 OwnedBedCount: int      謇謖√・繝・ラ邱乗焚・磯・鄂ｮ貂医∩・区悴驟咲ｽｮ縺ｮ蜷郁ｨ茨ｼ・```

**繝ｫ繝ｼ繝ｫ:**
- 蝨溷慍雉ｼ蜈･・・ﾃ・・俄・ 縺昴・菴咲ｽｮ縺ｫ Room 縺悟叉譎ら函謌舌よ里蟄・Room 縺ｨ謗･縺吶ｋ霎ｺ縺ｮ螢∽ｸｭ螟ｮ縺ｫ繝峨い縺悟曙譁ｹ蜷代〒髢九￥
- 蛻晄悄迥ｶ諷・ 10ﾃ・0 = 2ﾃ・ 驟咲ｽｮ縺ｮ Room 4 縺､縺梧磁邯壽ｸ医∩・医ラ繧｢險・4 邂・園・・- 繝吶ャ繝峨・ `OwnedBedCount - PlacedBedCount > 0` 縺ｮ譚｡莉ｶ縺ｮ縺ｿ縺ｧ驟咲ｽｮ蜿ｯ閭ｽ
- 驟咲ｽｮ菴咲ｽｮ縺ｮ蛻ｶ邏・ Room 蜀・Κ縺九▽螢√・繝峨い繝ｻ莉悶・繝・ラ縺ｨ驥崎､・＠縺ｪ縺・％縺ｨ

```csharp
// namespace: DungeonInn.Domain.Inn
public class InnLand
{
    public IReadOnlyList<Room> Rooms { get; }
    public Money Funds { get; private set; }
    public int OwnedBedCount { get; private set; }
    public int PlacedBedCount => Rooms.Sum(r => r.Beds.Count);
    public int UnplacedBedCount => OwnedBedCount - PlacedBedCount;

    public InnLand(IEnumerable<Room> initialRooms, Money initialFunds, int initialBedCount);

    // 髫｣謗･繝√ぉ繝・け繝ｻ雉・≡繝√ぉ繝・け 竊・Room 逕滓・ 竊・髫｣謗･ Room 縺ｨ縺ｮ髢薙↓繝峨い繧帝幕縺・    // 謌ｻ繧雁､: 逕滓・縺輔ｌ縺・Room
    public Room PurchaseParcel(GridPosition origin, Money cost);
    // 譛ｪ謇譛峨・髫｣謗･貂医∩繝ｻ雉・≡蜈・ｶｳ 縺ｮ 3 譚｡莉ｶ繧堤｢ｺ隱・    public bool CanPurchaseAt(GridPosition origin, Money cost);
    public Room? GetRoomContaining(GridPosition worldPos);
    public void AddFunds(Money amount);
    public bool TrySpendFunds(Money amount);
    public void AddBeds(int count);
}

public class Room
{
    public Guid Id { get; }
    // 繝ｯ繝ｼ繝ｫ繝峨げ繝ｪ繝・ラ荳翫・蟾ｦ荳玖ｧ抵ｼ・=0 蝗ｺ螳夲ｼ・    public GridPosition Origin { get; }
    public int Width { get; }   // = 5・亥崋螳夲ｼ・    public int Depth { get; }   // = 5・亥崋螳夲ｼ・    public IReadOnlyList<Bed> Beds { get; }
    // 螢√・縺・■髢区叛縺輔ｌ縺ｦ縺・ｋ繝ｯ繝ｼ繝ｫ繝峨げ繝ｪ繝・ラ蠎ｧ讓呻ｼ磯團謗･ Room 雉ｼ蜈･譎ゅ↓霑ｽ蜉・・    public IReadOnlyList<GridPosition> DoorPositions { get; }

    public Room(Guid id, GridPosition origin, int width, int depth);

    // 蠅・阜螢∽ｸ翫°縺､迴ｾ蝨ｨ髢峨§縺ｦ縺・ｋ菴咲ｽｮ縺ｫ繝峨い繧定ｿｽ蜉縺吶ｋ
    public void OpenDoor(GridPosition wallPos);
    // 繝吶ャ繝蛾・鄂ｮ蜿ｯ蜷ｦ: Room 蜀・Κ && 螢√〒縺ｪ縺・&& 繝峨い縺ｧ縺ｪ縺・&& 譌｢蟄倥・繝・ラ縺ｪ縺・    public bool CanPlaceBedAt(GridPosition worldPos);
    public void PlaceBed(Bed bed);
    public void RemoveBed(Guid bedId);
    // 謖・ｮ壼ｺｧ讓吶′蠅・阜縺九▽繝峨い縺ｧ縺ｪ縺・竊・螢・    public bool IsWall(GridPosition worldPos);
    public bool Contains(GridPosition worldPos);
    // 貅雜ｳ蠎ｦ險育ｮ礼畑
    public float Density => (float)Beds.Count / ((Width - 2) * (Depth - 2));  // 蜀・Κ繧ｻ繝ｫ縺ｧ險育ｮ・}

public class Bed
{
    public Guid Id { get; }
    public GridPosition Position { get; }  // 繝ｯ繝ｼ繝ｫ繝峨げ繝ｪ繝・ラ蠎ｧ讓・    public bool IsOccupied { get; private set; }

    public Bed(Guid id, GridPosition position);
    public void CheckIn();
    public void CheckOut();
}
```

#### 繝峨い縺ｮ髢区叛繝ｭ繧ｸ繝・け・・nnLand 蜀・Κ・・

### 4.3 Character

```csharp
// namespace: DungeonInn.Domain.Character
public abstract class CharacterBase
{
    public int Hp { get; protected set; }
    public int MaxHp { get; }
    public int AttackPower { get; }
    public int Defense { get; }
    public float MoveSpeed { get; }
    public float AttackSpeed { get; }

    protected CharacterBase(int maxHp, int attackPower, int defense, float moveSpeed, float attackSpeed);
    public bool IsAlive => Hp > 0;
    public void TakeDamage(int amount);
    public void Heal(int amount);
}

// 繝励Ξ繧､繝､繝ｼ縺梧桃菴懊☆繧句髪荳縺ｮ繧ｭ繝｣繝ｩ繧ｯ繧ｿ繝ｼ縲よ姶髣倥ヱ繝ｩ繝｡繝ｼ繧ｿ縺ｯ菫晄戟縺吶ｋ縺梧姶髣倥・繧ｹ繧ｳ繝ｼ繝怜､・public class InnkeeperCharacter : CharacterBase
{
    public InnkeeperCharacter(int maxHp, int attackPower, int defense, float moveSpeed, float attackSpeed)
        : base(maxHp, attackPower, defense, moveSpeed, attackSpeed);
}

// NPC縲ょｮｿ螻・竊・繝繝ｳ繧ｸ繝ｧ繝ｳ 竊・螳ｿ螻・繧偵Ν繝ｼ繝励☆繧玖・蠕九お繝ｼ繧ｸ繧ｧ繝ｳ繝・public class AdventurerCharacter : CharacterBase
{
    public Guid Id { get; }
    public Satisfaction CurrentSatisfaction { get; private set; }
    public AdventurerState State { get; private set; }

    public AdventurerCharacter(Guid id, int maxHp, int attackPower, int defense, float moveSpeed, float attackSpeed);
    public void UpdateSatisfaction(Satisfaction satisfaction);
    public void TransitionState(AdventurerState next);
}

public enum AdventurerState
{
    Resting,            // 螳ｿ螻九〒莨第・荳ｭ
    TravelingToDungeon, // 繝繝ｳ繧ｸ繝ｧ繝ｳ縺ｸ遘ｻ蜍穂ｸｭ
    ExploringDungeon,   // 繝繝ｳ繧ｸ繝ｧ繝ｳ謗｢邏｢荳ｭ
    Returning,          // 螳ｿ螻九∈蟶ｰ驍・ｸｭ
}

// 蜷・嚴螻､縺ｫ逕滓・縺吶ｋ繝｢繝ｳ繧ｹ繧ｿ繝ｼ
public class MonsterCharacter : CharacterBase
{
    public int FloorIndex { get; }  // 0=蝨ｰ荳・F 縲・4=蝨ｰ荳・F
    public GridPosition PatrolTarget { get; private set; }

    public MonsterCharacter(int floorIndex, int maxHp, int attackPower, int defense, float moveSpeed, float attackSpeed);
    public void SetPatrolTarget(GridPosition target);
}
```

## 8. AI 繧｢繝ｼ繧ｭ繝・け繝√Ε・・pplication 螻､・・
```csharp
// namespace: DungeonInn.Application.AI

// 蜀帝匱閠・AI 縺ｮ謚ｽ雎｡縲ょｷｮ縺玲崛縺亥庄閭ｽ縺ｫ縺吶ｋ・井ｻ墓ｧ・6.2・・public interface IAdventurerAI
{
    void OnStateEnter(AdventurerCharacter character, AdventurerState state);
    // 谺｡縺ｮ逶ｮ讓・GridPosition 繧定ｿ斐☆縲ら岼讓吶↑縺励↑繧・null
    GridPosition? Tick(AdventurerCharacter character, float deltaTime);
    void OnStateExit(AdventurerCharacter character, AdventurerState state);
}

// 繝・ヵ繧ｩ繝ｫ繝亥ｮ溯｣・ 繧ｹ繝・・繝医・繧ｷ繝ｳ繝吶・繧ｹ

{
    // 蜷・せ繝・・繝医ｒ IAdventurerAIState 縺ｫ蟋碑ｭｲ縺吶ｋ
}

// 繧ｹ繝・・繝医・蜀・Κ繧､繝ｳ繧ｿ繝ｼ繝輔ぉ繝ｼ繧ｹ・・efaultAdventurerAI 蜀・Κ縺ｮ縺ｿ菴ｿ逕ｨ・・internal interface IAdventurerAIState
{
    AdventurerState StateType { get; }

    GridPosition? Tick(AdventurerCharacter character, float deltaTime);
    void Exit(AdventurerCharacter character);
}

// 蜈ｷ菴鍋噪縺ｪ繧ｹ繝・・繝・// RestingState       : 螳ｿ螻九・繝吶ャ繝峨〒蠕・ｩ溘３estDuration 邨碁℃蠕・竊・TravelingToDungeon 縺ｸ
// TravelingState     : 繝繝ｳ繧ｸ繝ｧ繝ｳ蜈･蜿｣縺ｸ遘ｻ蜍輔ょ芦驕斐〒 竊・ExploringDungeon 縺ｸ

// ReturningState     : 螳ｿ螻句・蜿｣縺ｸ遘ｻ蜍輔ょ芦驕斐〒繝√ぉ繝・け繧､繝ｳ 竊・Resting 縺ｸ
```

- `IAdventurerAI.Tick()` 縺ｯ谺｡縺ｮ逶ｮ讓・`GridPosition` 繧定ｿ斐☆縺縺・- `NavMeshAgent.SetDestination()` 縺ｯ View 螻､縺ｮ `AdventurerPresenter`・・onoBehaviour・峨′蜻ｼ縺ｶ
- 縺薙ｌ縺ｫ繧医ｊ AI 繧・NavMesh 縺ｫ髱樔ｾ晏ｭ倥↓菫昴■縲∝ｰ・擂縺ｮ繧ｫ繧ｹ繧ｿ繝螳溯｣・∈縺ｮ蟾ｮ縺玲崛縺医ｒ蜿ｯ閭ｽ縺ｫ縺吶ｋ
